name: gameloop-spectator-6v6-1080p
note: The one layout: first-person SPECTATOR, 6v6 round-based WoW room, GameLoop 1920x1080. Measured on Video_Project_9 (2026-10-04); banner and Remaining checked on Video_Project_13 (2026-10-07).

banner.box_min_frac_note: Share of each score box (blue_score_box / red_score_box) that must be team-coloured for the banner to count as up. Video_Project_9/_13: 0.61-0.83 with a one-digit score, 0.38-0.40 with '10', 0.00 when hidden. Replaces three sample points that a two-digit score covered.

scoreboard.value_cols_note: Headers on the 6v6 round AND match boards (Video_Project_9 round 1, Video_Project_11): No. of Eliminations, Assists, Damage Dealt, Damage Taken, Knock Outs. The old names (col_1..col_4, damage_dealt) were copied from the 2v2 board and put Knock Outs under damage_dealt.
scoreboard.digit_min_score_note: Video_Project_11: every misread board glyph (6->9, 8->9, split from touching digits) scored <= 0.807; 95% of correct glyphs score >= 0.858, and the held-out round board's lowest is 0.845.
scoreboard.match_board_min_s_note: A board on screen at least this long, or still up when the recording ends, is the end-of-match board. Round boards are up 2.8-2.9 s (the game's Next Round countdown) on every round of 2026-10-04 22-55-47.

max_align_lag_note: Feed rows are paced ~2.5 s apart, so a multi-kill backs the queue up: on Video_Project_9 four deaths at 146.5-147.0 s were printed until 155.4 s (8.9 s). 8.0 left the last one unaligned and its drop counted twice. Same-round guard still applies.
